25127713.name: Poziotinib
25127713.description: Poziotinib is a drug in development by Hanmi Pharmaceutical , Luye Pharma , and Spectrum Pharmaceuticals for various cancers.

25185057.name: Lefamulin
25185057.description: Lefamulin, sold under the brand name Xenleta, is an antibiotic medication used to treat adults with community-acquired bacterial pneumonia.

44608289.name: Emrusolmin
44608289.description: Emrusolmin is an experimental drug for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases.

44719521.name: Ψ-2C-T-4
44719521.description: Ψ-2C-T-4, or psi-2C-T-4, also known as 4-isopropylthio-2,6-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and Ψ-PEA families.

54704417.name: Germicidin
54704417.description: Germicidins are a groups of natural products arising from Streptomyces species that acts as autoregulatory inhibitor of spore germination.

56841889.name: Danoprevir
56841889.description: Danoprevir is an orally available 15-membered macrocyclic peptidomimetic inhibitor of NS3/4A HCV protease.

76960417.name: Cefilavancin
76960417.description: Cefilavancin is an experimental antibiotic medication developed for the treatment of bacterial infections such as drug-resistant strains of Staphylococcus aureus.

91365537.name: Scillavone B
91365537.description: Scillavone B is a homoisoflavone that can be isolated from the bulbs of Scilla scilloides .

92002593.name: Ibritumomab tiuxetan
92002593.description: Ibritumomab tiuxetan , sold under the trade name Zevalin, is a monoclonal antibody radioimmunotherapy treatment for non-Hodgkin's lymphoma.

92135969.name: H3B-8800
92135969.description: H3B-8800 is an experimental drug which acts as an inhibitor of the SF3B1 protein, which forms part of the splicing factor 3b protein complex.

112500385.name: Methyldiazinol
112500385.description: Methyldiazinol (also known as 3,3-azo-17α-methyl-5α-dihydrotestosterone, 3-azi-17α-methyl-DHT, or 3,3-azo-17α-methyl-5α-androstan-17β-ol) is a synthetic and orally active androgen/anabolic steroid...

118572065.name: Mevrometostat
118572065.description: Mevrometostat is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated by Pfizer for the treatment of metastatic castration‑resistant prostate cancer . It is a EZH2 histone methyltransferase inhibitor.

121488161.name: PL-3994
121488161.description: PL-3994 is an experimental bronchodilator that acts as an agonist of the natriuretic peptide receptor A. It is developed by Palatin Technologies.

121596705.name: PZM21
121596705.description: PZM21 is an experimental opioid analgesic drug that is being researched for the treatment of pain.

125369761.name: PX-2
125369761.description: PX-2 (also known as 5F-APP-PINACA, FU-PX and PPA -2201) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold online as a designer drug.

134819873.name: LY-2459989
134819873.description: LY-2459989 is a silent antagonist of the κ-opioid receptor that has been developed by Eli Lilly as a radiotracer of that receptor, labeled either with carbon-11 or fluorine-18.

137332257.name: AB-PICA
137332257.description: AB-PICA is a potent agonist for the CB1 receptor and CB2 receptor .

146158369.name: Urotensin-II
146158369.description: Urotensin-II is a peptide ligand that is the strongest known vasoconstrictor.

156963489.name: Lipo-oxytocin-1
156963489.description: Lipo-oxytocin-1 is a synthetic peptide and derivative of oxytocin that acts as an agonist of the oxytocin receptor.

159065121.name: Lanthanum diiodide
159065121.description: Lanthanum diiodide is an iodide of lanthanum, with the chemical formula of LaI2. It is an electride, actually having a chemical formula of La3+[ 2e−].

165361441.name: Βk-2C-I
165361441.description: βk-2C-I, or bk-2C-I, also known as β-keto-4-iodo-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine or as β-keto-2C-I, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and 2C families related to 2C-I.

165412129.name: 2C-B-AN
165412129.description: 2C-B-AN, also known as 4-bromo-N- -2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine or as brolphetaminil, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and N-benzylphenethylamine families related to 2C-B.

177841569.name: Iodyl trifluoride
177841569.description: Iodyl trifluoride is an inorganic compound of iodine, fluorine, and oxygen with the chemical formula IO2F3. The compound was first obtained by Engelbrecht and Petersy in 1969.

900000033.name: 2CB-2,5-DiEtO
900000033.description: 2CB-2,5-DiEtO, also known as 2,5-diethoxy-4-bromophenethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and TWEETIO families related to the psychedelic drug 2C-B.

900000161.name: Ammonium hexaiodoplatinate(IV)
900000161.description: Ammonium hexaiodoplatinate is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula 2[PtI6]. It forms dark-red, cubic crystals.

900000289.name: Birch triterpenes
900000289.description: Birch triterpenes, sold under the brand name Filsuvez, is an extract of birch bark used as a topical medication for the treatment of epidermolysis bullosa.

900000417.name: Carlumab
900000417.description: Carlumab is a discontinued human recombinant monoclonal antibody that targets human CC chemokine ligand 2 /monocyte chemoattractant protein .

900000801.name: Exbivirumab
900000801.description: Exbivirumab is a human monoclonal antibody developed for the treatment of hepatitis B infections.

900000929.name: Hassium tetroxide
900000929.description: Hassium tetroxide (also hassium oxide) is the inorganic compound with the formula HsO4.

900001057.name: Ixekizumab
900001057.description: Ixekizumab, sold under the brand name Taltz, is an injectable medication for the treatment of autoimmune diseases.

900001185.name: Lumretuzumab
900001185.description: Lumretuzumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody designed for the treatment of cancer. This drug was developed by Genentech/Roche.

900001441.name: Otelixizumab
900001441.description: Otelixizumab, also known as TRX4, is a monoclonal antibody, which is being developed for the treatment of type 1 diabetes and other autoimmune diseases.

900001569.name: Plutonium oxybromide
900001569.description: Plutonium oxybromide is an inorganic compound of plutonium, oxygen, and bromine with the chemical formula PuOBr.

900002081.name: Tris(silox)tantalum
900002081.description: Tris tantalum, Ta 3, is an organotantalum complex bound with three siloxide (this siloxide has three tert-butyl groups attached to silicon, attached via oxygen ) ligands.
